fixtureProtocol.integrator: Stage A fixed-step semi-implicit rigid-body integrator
fixtureProtocol.initialGeometryProtocol: fixed idealized constitutional coordinates in Angstroms; deterministic LCG orientation seeds

waterWater.normalRegionDefinition: minimum real-atom pair distance >=2.8 Å; closer samples are reported as severe-overlap region
